name: The Tower of Babel
storyline:
You head to the building, which has been calling you this whole time. You hear its voice. It wants you to uncover all its secrets along the way.

You put your helmet on, load your pistol, and enter this journey.
summary: The Tower of Babel is a 40-map megawad built by 25 talented, beautiful, and humble mappers where your goal is simple : ascend the enigmatic tower, floor by floor, and discover what awaits you at the top - if there is a top, that is. On your climb, you'll encounter galvanic techbases, hellish strongholds, dazzling Doomcute, and... pizza (or gutza, whatever the locals call it) - all crammed into the coolest, Doom 2 vanilla-textured 1024 x 1024 maps around. The wonderful synergy between maps make this megawad a really enjoyable one. The higher you go into the tower, the better it gets. So much so, that you will be wanting more at the end.
